fields.title: Column with class labels
fields.description: Select the column to be used as classification attribute. This column must contain nominal values.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Number of neighbors to consider (k)
fields.description: The number of nearest neighbors used to classify a new instance. An odd number is recommended to avoid ties.

fields.title: Weight neighbors by distance
fields.description:
If enabled, the distance of each neighbor to the query pattern influences its weight
in the classification. Closer neighbors have greater influence on the result.
Note: Only k neighbors are considered, regardless of weighting.

fields.title: Output class probabilities
fields.description:
If enabled, additional columns containing the class probabilities for each predicted class
will be appended to the output.
